text:
alex: Noticing billing attribution flips when proxy swaps origin. Key owned by proj-alpha but billing shows proj-beta. @rachel can you look?

rachel: Can you paste headers/logs?

alex: short logs:
INFO auth: key=abc owner=proj-alpha
INFO proxy: exchange -> set X-Exec-Project=proj-beta
INFO billing: project=proj-beta key=abc

omar: we should enforce owner-by-default for quotas and emit an attribution header so downstream is unambiguous.

rachel: Agreed. Proposal: auth emits X-Auth-Attribution: owner=proj-alpha;exec=proj-beta and billing prefers owner unless key has billing_target=exec.

alex: ok. rachel, open ticket and add a tiny adaptive sampler for traces. ops-bot create a task.

ops-bot: @rachel mentioned in eng-platform  created AUTH-9001
